"Launch emails timed to the drop. Digital marketing across Nordstrom's owned channels, social cut for each platform" plus the campaign assets grid
Photography was supplied and "everything else was open": the visual language, polygon crops and grayscale-to-color scroll were directed onto it
"Typography at Volume" — big type, mixed weights, baselines off the grid; "CONFIDENCE IS STRENGTH" lockups fill the screens
Motion studies, polygon rotating on scroll as "one CSS transform", full-bleed video that played on scroll
"in-store signage for the locations carrying the line"; ivy-signage.jpg shows a backlit lightbox poster reading "CONFIDENCE IS STRENGTH"
"Launch emails timed to the drop" and the polygon running "into the email headers"
"Pattern design" declared and shown in frames like the peony wallpaper pattern field and halftone/geometric motif marks
Prose: hero, secondary and accent patterns "made to layer from a single dish up to a full setting"; mockups show dinner plates, salad plates and chargers
"A.R.C., an iPhone app I designed and built for home inventory" with app screens throughout the mockups
OpenAI Vision API and Perceptron Mk1 recognition; frame arc-pipeline-cloud-sync-step reads "Analyzing your photos with AI..."
Declares Product Design; screens like arc-ui-report-configuration-pdf and arc-ui-category-insights show a designed end-to-end flow
"I built A.R.C. end to end: concept, code" — Python, Streamlit, Supabase, Vercel stack
Brand Identity declared; chromatic-brand-circle frame sets #B1BC94 primary, warm register and ground colours
arc-logo-grid shows the "a.r.c. / archive ready cloud" wordmark on a construction grid
The study is the photographs themselves — "Photographs from a family trip through far West Texas," shot on a Fuji X-T30, and every frame catalogued is a photograph.
Three lithographs set in script, geometric capitals and slab serifs — "Every stroke gets a different fill" and letterforms dominate every flat artwork frame.
Twelve pattern tiles built from six shapes, shown as sixteen swatch frames (diamond grid, halftone dots, hairlines, diagonal stripes).
"Black ink on white paper" — three lithographs, shown as printed posters on a wood table and leaning on a gate.
Declared discipline, and the prose sets the governing rules: "With no color, spacing is the only tone control" and three ratios of ink to paper across the sheets.
"Five logos for five clients" — identity work for a fashion collective, a DJ, a lifestyle brand, each with its own look
Five logo frames: spear COLLECTIVE vines, hey! SD stellar jay, OKINA orbit wordmark, DJ MIA halftone, J. CHRISTIANSON four-circle mark
"Album covers, posters, art prints" — framed print mockups like "CANDY PAINT", "Your Reflection Is Me", "Verse02"
"hand-drawn type where a piece called for it" and the "ABC-123" typography exercise poster
The 4x6 film shot is itself the work — "branding-graphics-bokeh-lights-source-photograph.jpg" blown up for the Bokeh's Fall window
"radial color studies built from pattern" — halftone dot fields, argyle diamonds, harlequin and pinstripe fills across the album and print frames
"Brand identity for Capitan Boot Co." — primary logo, badges, lockups, palette built as a system
Bull skull lockup on a geometric grid, buffalo mark and diamond badge in buffalo-logo.png and the CB monogram frame
"Northwest Regular and Oldman Regular are the type pairing" plus typographic lockups and letterspaced wordmark
"Apparel Graphics" declared; marks drawn to be "stitched into denim"
"The same person drew the marks and shot the pictures" — campaign shot on location in Big Bend
"a campaign shot in West Texas" with lockups sitting on the landscape photographs
"Took it down to the studs" — reclaimed pine, Malm fireplace, sputnik chandelier, and the A-frame interiors shown in chalet-living-room-wide and chalet-kitchen frames.
Scope declares "furniture and fixture sourcing" and finish selection; walnut dining set, leather sling chairs and ladder shelf appear in the living-room frames.
Homepage, global header, mobile layouts shown in cosmo-prof-ui-website-homepage-shinefinity-hero-product-mockup and homepage-mobile frames
"$16.99", "ADD TO CART", "SHOP THE VIDEO", price lines and catalog rows in cosmo-prof-ui-website-homepage-2
"Started with photography: high-contrast lighting, defined shadows" — six original product frames define the library
"Jost does all of it. ExtraBold for the wordmark... Light for captions and price lines"
"tabbed recommendations personalized to each stylist" / "The tabs sort to whoever is logged in"
"The templates set photography, type and layout once" — promotions, campaigns and education run on the same slots
"design and build a marketing site: black and white, big condensed type" — shown in dsc-marketing-site-laptop-hero and marketing-site-facilities-equipment frames.
"An athlete app for booking sessions and an owner console" — login, dashboard, calendar and roster screens catalogued.
MCP server with eleven tools; dsc-claude-mcp-chat-booking-request and the console's batch scheduler chat ("SAY 'COMMIT' TO CONFIRM").
Two-faced scheduling platform designed around approval flow — owner console request card with "APPROVE / Decline" and athlete "UP NEXT" dashboard.
"Design and full-stack, brand to backend": Next.js on Vercel, OAuth 2.0 consent screen with short-lived tokens, deterministic booking engine.
"a brand that matched where the gym was headed" — monogram mark, DALLAS SPORT COLLECTIVE wordmark, black/white/grey palette and Avenir Next weight ramp.
Prose declares "Interior design, furniture curation, finish selection" for a two-story foyer; hero5.webp shows the finished room with pendant, bench and doors.
"All of it had been somewhere else first. The rug, the bench and the two pieces of art, all found" — vintage runner and found pieces visible in 3.webp and hero5.webp.
Prose and photographs are a built sitting room — ledgestone fireplace wall, black box beams, swivel chair grouping — declared as "Interior design" scope.
Declares "Furniture Curation, Finish Selection" and specifies pieces and finishes — charcoal velvet swivels, hand-rubbed brass drum table, round cane-front bar cabinet, white oak floors.
"Interior design, finish selection, fixture sourcing, furniture curation" for a 600 sq ft primary suite and ensuite
Declares "Fixture Sourcing" and "Furniture Curation" — copper tub, chandeliers, velvet sofa, marble side table selected piece by piece
Three residential bathrooms designed around a shared kit — 'urban southwest', 'modern farmhouse', 'quiet glam' — shown in finished-room photographs.
'Hard surface selections' and material selection — marble, dolomite, white oak, tile all picked at once on one moodboard.
"Interior design, fixture sourcing, art selection, furniture curation" for a 400 sq ft primary bath with two vanities, tub and marble shower.
"None of it came from one vendor or was ordered to spec" — fixture sourcing, antique valet stand, vintage rugs, seen in the his-vanity frame.
Whole study is a ground-up kitchen — space planning, cabinetry, island, dining area, construction documentation, shown in room-wide frames like hill-country-kitchen-full-view-beams-runner-island.jpg
Declares "Fixture Selection" and "Material Specification"; prose selects vintage cremone bolts, schoolhouse pendants, leather safari chairs and a turned-leg table to one four-finish spec
"Interior design, furniture curation, art selection" of a living room around a limestone fireplace wall, shown in the room photographs.
Scope names "fixture sourcing" and furniture/art collected piece by piece — brass fixtures, vintage globe, gilt-framed paintings in frame.
Prose: "A campaign ... from billboards down to phone wallpapers" — one idea sized across banner, posters, wallpaper, shirt.
Declares "Art direction and campaign design"; the mid-century landscape artworks set palette and oak-silhouette look.
Two logo frames of the three-line "HILL COUNTRY OAKWORKS" wordmark with construction circle and grid guides.
Specimen frame of the "OAK BARRELS. MASTER CRAFT. HERITAGE WHISKEY." lockup plus the Greatdome/Avenir Next role assignments.
Posters and outdoor banner: "Greatdome is on the headlines and the posters" and the billboard mockup.
Photograph of a man in a crew-neck tee with the printed wordmark; build list names "a shirt".
"the brand started from nothing: the name first, then the mark, the palette, the type, and the product graphics"
prose and scope state the name was created first: "The name came first, then the mark, then the tree."
four-circle mark recolored by context, seen as the four-dot circle mark and twenty-circle grid in the sign and pattern frames
striped field and dot-grid patterns in j-christianson-dot-grid-pattern-brown-accents and -olive-accents
storefront sign, billboard and backlit outdoor poster mockups: "The whole year lit up on the sign"
Product page frame shows "Sacai Luck", "$470", add-to-bag and "SELECT SIZE"; prose calls it Jeffrey's first online store.
"Modular grids so the layouts could change with the season" plus template spread of homepage/designer/product screens.
Prose: "the brand around it" — palette, wordmark and type all specified as a brand system.
jeffrey-new-york-wordmark-logo-lockup.jpg shows the JEFFREY wordmark with construction circle and grid rules.
One family, Avenir Next Heavy/Demi Bold/Medium doing the hierarchy; wordmark set wide and locked tight.
"An editorial pace built into the structure of the site"; homepage editorial spread and designer takeovers like DRIES VAN NOTEN, VETEMENTS.
"a spring campaign that looked like it had been shot on location" running across email, homepage and social as one kit
Declares art direction; studio set built from cropped monstera and palm fronds as architecture, color floods and extreme crops
Studio photography is the work itself — dresses and the two leaves "shot once on white", seen in the monstera-leaf and palm-frond texture detail photographs
"The type is one family, Avenir Next, italic Heavy for the wordmark and Medium, Demi Bold and Heavy" — condensed, stretched, layered headline type like "IN SEASON BOLD, READY & NOW."
Scope names "email and web templates"; the kit ran on email as one of three formats
Desktop and mobile homepage screens with JEFFREY nav bar, Women/Culture/Designers/Men and SHOP NOW
"A year-long campaign on one tile template, across social, email, in-store signage, and web" — twelve months of Liked/Loved tiles.
Fixed grid, type and heart icon with two tiers merchandising could swap into weekly without a brief.
"no new art direction, just a crop spec" — crops and compositions specified per tier, e.g. the TIBI fur coat and portrait tiles.
"The tile you saw in a feed was the one you saw in the store window" — in-store signage at full scale.
Landing page frame shows an editorial layout with pull quote and brand-organized stories; "Editorial Systems" declared.
"Twelve months across social feeds, email sends, in-store signage, and web landing pages."
"InSite was Neiman Marcus's digital editorial hub" — designer spotlights, color stories and typographic spreads built to feel like a magazine.
"Designer names ran as big as the photographs"; frames like the-rocker and classic-beauty show display serifs and swash letterforms wrapped into the figure.
Declares Art Direction and Photo Direction; "Scale, weight and position came out of the story's concept, and the photographer got briefed with those."
"The mandate was to make the website feel like a magazine" — laptop mockups show the spreads running on screen (rainbow-laptop, minimalism-laptop).
"sell product like a store" and "shoppers reached the product page"; ways-to-wear spreads itemize BLACK DRESS + DENIM JACKET + SILK BLOUSE as shoppable product.
"All of it was studio photography" shot on seamless paper with poses briefed per story; studio-shot frames throughout.
Frames show 'Add to Bag', '$17.50', 'Free shipping', size and quantity steppers in the shoppable drawer; declares Ecommerce Design.
A Nordstrom beauty editorial hub built in their CMS with custom components and HTML/CSS/JS, shown as desktop and mobile pages.
Declares Product Design and UX Design; designed the try-on tool, shoppable drawer and template behaviour.
'Three modular story formats, each written in an editorial voice' — 'Get That Glow', 'Top 5 Serums' with headlines and body copy per story.
Virtual try-on: upload a selfie or pull the Style Profile photo and drag a gradient to preview shades on your own face.
"A content framework from scratch: four named buckets, each with its own typographic mark and icon" running homepage, email and landing pages
Named the four buckets "What's Now," "On Our List," "Where to Wear," "Wear to Where"
Lockup frames show the italic script marks plus lightning-bolt, check and arrow glyphs laid over the photography
"Sourced a different typeface for every lockup, so no two of them share a face"
Nordstrom.com homepage and landing page mockups (hero2, hero3) with shopping modules like "Sunglasses Under $100" and "The List: Hobo Bags"
"Once it shipped it ran homepage modules, email sections, and dedicated landing pages"
Frames show Nordstrom nav with WOMEN/MEN/SALE, product tiles and prices like "$78", and the prose calls the shots "ecomm" grid listings.
"A different homepage for each shopper" — Savvy Mag, Summer to Fall, city essentials, with "Hi, Gabby" and "Hi, Toby" in frame.
"Built the layouts on three tile shapes... rules were strict enough to run at that scale" across breakpoints.
Homepage and category pages built in the CMS, shown as laptop and phone screenshots of the Nordstrom site restacking for smaller screens.
Declared scope; "consistent eye level, deliberate contrast, precise angles, no styling props" governs the imagery.
Product photography direction is part of the work — white seamless, one shadow throughout — and the catalogue includes the studio product shots (backpack, moto jacket, pumps).
"A spring campaign for Neiman Marcus... run across social, email, the stores, and editorial"
Declared discipline, borne out by the built reference — "One model, four setups" and the mall-glam studio look in the portrait frames
The shoot is the work — one studio day, four photographs, Capture One, double exposures layered into every piece
"Archer Hairline is thin enough to sit over the pictures" and Archer Book for body; wordmark letterforms in the logo frame
robert-rodriguez-logo frame: hairline wordmark, overlapping lowercase serif signature on mesh gradient, text "ROBERT rodriguez"
"the editorial spreads gave the double exposures room to run wide"

Declared discipline and shown in the work: designing the feed, Sally's Take, Approve flow and Campaigns rail.
Prose: "Design and full-stack, brand to backend" — Python, Next.js, Supabase + pgvector, Figma plugin code.
Prose: emails "assemble out of the product's own component library," plus Design System listed as a discipline.

Brand system of pink/cyan, one type family and a grid held constant "so a phone screen and a store sign look like the same brand."
lockup.jpg is the painted "YOU BY SALLY." wordmark shown with construction and circle guides.
"Avenir Next Heavy for the wordmark, Demi Bold for the shade names... Medium for everything else."
